tagline: We are the Pinnacle of the Roofing Industry

awards: Excalibur Award — awarded to the "Top 60 Roofing Contractors in the United States" — earned every year from 1994 to the present. Given to Versico's most prominent and successful authorized contractors.

services.title: Commercial Flat Roofing
services.short_description: Single-ply membrane systems installed on low-slope commercial roofs across Northeastern PA.
services.long_description: Flat and low-slope roofs are what we do. We install all types of single-ply membrane, spec the insulation to the building rather than to a catalog page, and detail the flashings, curbs and terminations that are where flat roofs actually fail. Every system we install carries a manufacturer warranty.

services.title: Commercial Roof Replacement & New Construction
services.short_description: Full tear-off and re-roofing, plus new-construction roofing for institutional, industrial and retail buildings.
services.long_description: From new construction to complete re-roofing, we handle the whole scope — tear-off, deck evaluation, insulation, membrane, and all the sheet metal that goes with it. We have installed on hospitals, universities, plants, schools and municipal buildings across Luzerne, Lackawanna and Monroe counties since 1993.

services.title: Roof Repair & Emergency Leak Service
services.short_description: On-call technicians from two Northeastern PA locations for active leaks and storm damage.
services.long_description: When a roof is leaking into occupied space, the cost is the disruption, not the patch. We keep on-call service technicians at both our Nanticoke and Dickson City locations so we can get on-site quickly, find the actual source, and stop the water — then give you a straight answer about whether it is a repair or the start of a bigger problem.

services.title: Preventative Maintenance & Roof Inspections
services.short_description: Scheduled inspections and maintenance that extend roof life and keep the warranty intact.
services.long_description: Most commercial roofs do not fail from one dramatic event — they fail from small, unaddressed details over several winters, and the warranty claim gets denied because nobody documented anything. A scheduled maintenance and inspection program fixes both problems: it catches the details early and it builds the record that keeps your extended warranty coverage enforceable.

services.title: Architectural Metal & Sheet Metal
services.short_description: Architectural metal roofing, composite aluminum panels and custom sheet metal fabrication.
services.long_description: Sheet metal is in our name because it is half the job. We install architectural metal roofing and composite aluminum panel systems, and we fabricate the copings, counterflashings, gutters, scuppers and custom trim that make a commercial roof watertight where the membrane ends.

services.title: Energy Star White Roofing Systems
services.short_description: Reflective white membrane and high-R insulation that cut cooling load on large roof areas.
services.long_description: We are part of the Energy Star Savings Program. On buildings with big roof areas, a reflective white membrane paired with properly specified insulation measurably cuts the cooling load — and on a re-roof it is usually the cheapest efficiency upgrade available to the building, because the roof is already open.

about.story: Established in 1993, Pinnacle Roofing & Sheet Metal, Inc. has spent more than three decades putting commercial roofs on Northeastern Pennsylvania's hospitals, universities, plants, schools, banks and municipal buildings. The company takes pride in professionalism — you get the best possible craftsmanship and customer service when you work with us. From two locations, Nanticoke and Dickson City, we serve Luzerne, Lackawanna and Monroe counties.
